# Christopher Larsen, CPA

> A California CPA practice with three areas of focus: real estate accounting,
> small business accounting and tax, and personal tax preparation. For real
> estate, the work centers on lease compliance reviews and CAM (common area
> maintenance) audits for commercial tenants, owners, and operators. For small
> businesses, bookkeeping, monthly close, financial statements, and federal and
> California business tax returns. Based in Southern California, licensed and
> serving clients statewide.

## Facts

- Principal: Christopher D. Larsen, CPA. California CPA license No. 151422.
- Prior firms: EY (strategy and management consulting) and Deloitte (accounting and
  advisory). No current employer is named on this site.
- Service area: California, statewide.
- Contact: connect@larsen-cpa.com. No street address is published.
- The practice does not publish client names, engagement results, or testimonials.

## Primary service

Lease compliance and CAM audits for commercial tenants. The annual operating expense
or CAM reconciliation a landlord issues is examined against the tenant's own lease and
the supporting expense schedules. The output is a written memo in which each finding is
tied to a specific lease provision and a specific supporting schedule. Items examined:
overcharges, pro rata share errors, base year issues, expense cap violations, gross-up
errors, and improperly billed capital costs.

## Secondary services

- Small business accounting: bookkeeping and monthly close, financial statements,
  federal and California business tax returns, payroll and 1099 coordination, and
  QuickBooks and Xero setup and cleanup.
- Entity selection and formation guidance, budgeting and forecasting, and special projects.
- Lease accounting advisory: ASC 842 compliance, lease abstraction, lease accounting cleanup.
- Commercial lease audits beyond CAM: base rent verification, percentage rent audits.
- Landlord-side and property management accounting support.
- Expense reconciliation and financial cleanup for owners and operators.
- Ad hoc CPA advisory for real estate transactions.

Engagements are scoped and priced on their own terms, fixed or hourly; work is not
always contingency-based, and no recovery amount is promised.
